snippet.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Vice City, USA.
Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive.

Check out the new Launch Trailer, featuring new music from electronic duo Justice, composers of the original score from Grand Theft Auto VI.

The new standalone Justice single, “Flower in a Hurricane” feat. Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard, is also available on Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, the official soundtrack which is currently available to pre-save on all major music streaming services and up for pre-order on vinyl or CD at https://gtavi-thealbum.com.

Listen to “Flower in a Hurricane” now: https://justice.lnk.to/flowerinahurricane

This trailer was captured entirely in-game from a PlayStation 5.

Grand Theft Auto VI arrives November 19.

snippet.title: Kahit Di Na Tayo - Repablikan | Serenade Studio (Romantic Rock Cover)
snippet.description:
🎵 Title: Kahit Di Na Tayo (Romantic Rock Cover)
🎤 Original Artist: Repablikan
🎧 Produced by: Serenade Studio

“Kahit Di Na Tayo” captures the bittersweet feeling of loving someone even after your story together has ended. ❤️‍🩹 It's about accepting that two people can go their separate ways while still carrying the memories, promises, and love they once shared.

Sometimes, moving on doesn't mean forgetting. You can learn to live without someone, smile again, and find happiness in your own life, yet a part of your heart will always remember the person who once made everything feel complete. 💔🌙

“Kahit di na tayo, may parte pa rin ng puso kong mananatili sa'yo.”

There are love stories that don't end with forever. Some end with quiet goodbyes, unanswered questions, and memories that slowly fade into the background. But even when the relationship is over, the feelings don't always disappear as easily. 🥀

For this version, Serenade Studio reimagines “Kahit Di Na Tayo” by Repablikan with an emotional Acoustic Romantic Punk Rock arrangement, blending intimate acoustic guitar melodies, heartfelt Filipino vocals, nostalgic early-2000s emo-rock influences, atmospheric instrumentation, and powerful yet comforting rock dynamics. 🎸🌧️

With its nostalgic sound and bittersweet atmosphere, this rendition brings back the feeling of late-night memories, old conversations, and the kind of love that stays with you long after you've said your final goodbye. 🌆

✨ Para sa mga taong natutong bumitaw kahit mahal pa rin nila. Sa mga dating magkasintahang naging estranghero, at sa mga pusong tahimik pa ring nagmamahal kahit wala nang balikan—this one is for you. ❤️‍🩹

🎸 Serenade Studio

No original audio recordings, stems, or samples from the original track were used in this production.
